text:
Nora Blake: quick sync  marketplace readiness for Nimbus+SI certification + telemetry hooks. must finalize press window, cert checklist, and metrics tags by EOD Tue.
Carlos M.: certification update: HW QA passed functional tests; failing one perf case (cold start p95). ops recom mends a warm cache in staging.
Tanya Iyer: marketing: need final vendor quote + one customer blurb. also confirm telemetry UTM tags and analytics slug for marketplace listing.
Evan Holt: engineering: will add a short health endpoint and telemetry tags: utm_source=nimbus, utm_campaign=marketplace_q4. ETA for PR is Tue noon.
PR-bot: embargo proposal: Tue 11:00 PT to bloggers, Wed 07:00 PT public. legal requires signed co-announcement consent for any co-branded quote.
legal-bot: legal note: co-brand consent form uploaded: https://redwood.legal/coannounce-consent v1.0. must be signed before any vendor quote goes live.
Nora Blake: good. Carlos please confirm whether warm cache approach reduces cold start p95 below 350ms. we need that number for the performance blurb.
Carlos M.: running warm-cache test now; expect results in 90m. if still above threshold we fallback to quantized variant for hosted route during launch window.
Tanya Iyer: creative needs high-res badge + one-sentence SI partner line. if badge late, we'll use neutral hero and add "partner badge forthcoming".
Evan Holt: ops request: add a routing policy in playbook to send heavy inference to dedicated pool for first 72h and enable token-cost alerts. I'll submit PR to playbook.
ops-bot: deployment reminder created: Marketplace staging deploy Tue 17:00 PT (approvers: partnerships, eng-platform, marketing).
PR-bot: please DM PR lead with any embargo-exception outlet names. only one exception allowed and must be NDA-protected.
Nora Blake: action items recap:
- Marketing: finalize quote + analytic slugs (Tanya)
- Eng: warm-cache perf test + telemetry hook (Evan/Carlos)
- Legal: co-brand consent collection (legal-bot)
- Ops: routing policy + token-cost alerts (Evan)
- Creative: badge + hero fallback (Tanya)
Carlos M.: perf test update: warm-cache reduces cold start p95 to 320ms. committing warm cache config to staging.
Tanya Iyer: quote received from Nimbus AM. uploading to repo and will ask for consent signature.
legal-bot: consent received and signed by Nimbus product lead. stored: https://redwood.legal/consents/nimbus-1788888000.pdf
Nora Blake: excellent. final blocker check?
Evan Holt: one more ops note  set an alert if token cost / minute > $12 during first 24h. triggers incident channel and auto-fallthrough to quantized model.
ops-bot: alert rule created: cost-spike-nimbus v1.0.
Nora Blake: thanks team. I'll publish consolidated checklist and schedule a final pre-publish 30m call Tue 16:15 PT.
